name: nexus-bosses
title: Nexus Bosses
author: Alex Green
description: Nine summonable bosses for Nexus (Nexus Extended Promethium Endgame). Light a summon beacon, defend it through the countdown, then defeat the boss and claim its trophy. With the warp-drive gate enabled, place the warp key made from all nine trophies in the vault reliquary to research Silence and raise the relic.
